data.title: Why Does XRP Follow Bitcoin? Understanding the Correlation
data.description: XRP and Bitcoin tend to move together, but three specific events shattered that pattern and sent XRP in a completely different direction. Understanding what actually drives XRP independently reveals a tension that most crypto investors never see coming.
